phases: New prefix subprocess runs 2 optimizer steps, bind identity before/after prefix, then guarded resume subprocess runs 2 steps. Compare final state/history with original continuous reference.

fault_types.checkpoint-bytes: appended bytes to disposable checkpoint copy
fault_types.base-revision: runtime identity metadata injection; no wrong model downloaded
fault_types.tokenizer-files: runtime file-fingerprint metadata injection; original tokenizer untouched
fault_types.chat-template: runtime template-fingerprint metadata injection; original template untouched
fault_types.training-config: runtime LoRA-rank metadata injection; no wrong adapter constructed

acceptance: All eight negatives reject before checkpoint deserialization/training dispatch. Valid guarded resume equals continuous reference exactly. Checkpoint SHA unchanged. No model quality claim.
scope: New guarded entry point around frozen original worker. Same local environment; sidecar binding protects accidental mismatch/corruption, not hostile modification of sidecar itself. No concurrent-file locking or filesystem transaction/crash safety guarantee.
publication: Only JSON engineering records to private HF experiment branch; no checkpoints, raw data copies or debug weights uploaded.
